```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
spikes <- read.csv("data/log_spikes.csv")
labels <- read.csv("data/log_labels.csv")

data <- cbind(spikes, labels) %>%
  mutate(time = row_number())
```


# do neural states drift?

```{r}
key_list <- unique(labels$label)
correlations <- data.frame()

for(key in key_list){
  temp <- data %>%
    filter(label==key)
  
  last <- as.numeric(temp[nrow(temp), 1:100])
  prev <- temp[-nrow(temp), 1:100]
  
  corr <- apply(prev, 1, function(row){cor(as.numeric(row), last, method="pearson")})
  
  temp$r <- c(corr, NA)
  
  correlations <- rbind(correlations, temp %>% select(r,time,label))
}
```

```{r}
correlations %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c("man_s", "dog_s", "walks_v", "bites_v", "man_o", "dog_o", "_"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=time, y=r, color=label)) +
    facet_wrap(~label, ncol=2) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    theme_minimal()

# ggsave("figures/cross_cor.png", bg = "white")
```


# does representational geometry persist?

```{r}
key_list <- unique(data$label)
node_colnames <- names(data)[1:100]

n_windows <- 20

data_windowed <- data %>%
  mutate(window = cut(time,
                      breaks = seq(min(time, na.rm = TRUE), max(time, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n_windows + 1),
                      include.lowest = TRUE,
                      labels = FALSE))


# # randomly sample N observations per label per window
# 
# set.seed(42)
# 
# obs <- data_windowed %>%
#   count(window, label, name = "n_obs")
# 
# min_n <- min(obs$n_obs)
# 
# data_balanced <- data_windowed %>%
#   group_by(window, label) %>%
#   slice_sample(n=min_n)
# 
# avg_window <- data_balanced %>%
#   group_by(window, label) %>%
#   summarise(n_obs = n(), across(all_of(node_colnames), ~ mean(.x)))


avg_window <- data_windowed %>%
  group_by(window, label) %>%
  summarise(n_obs = n(), across(all_of(node_colnames), ~ mean(.x)))

            
# # check that windows contain every label
# 
# avg_window %>%
#   group_by(window) %>%
#   summarise(n_labels = n_distinct(label)) %>%
#   mutate(valid = n_labels == length(key_list))


# calculate RDM per window

rdm_list <- list()

for(w in c(1:n_windows)){
  temp <- avg_window %>%
    filter(window == w) %>%
    slice(match(key_list, label))

  X <- as.matrix(temp[, node_colnames])
  rownames(X) <- temp$label

  RDM <- as.matrix(dist(X, method = "euclidean"))
  # RDM <- 1 - cor(t(X), method = "pearson")

  rdm_list[[as.character(w)]] <- RDM
}


# compare across windows

rdm_vectors <- lapply(rdm_list, function(RDM) {RDM[upper.tri(RDM)]})

rsa_matrix <- cor(do.call(cbind, rdm_vectors), method = "pearson")
dimnames(rsa_matrix) <- list(names(rdm_list), names(rdm_list))

rsa_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(rsa_matrix))
names(rsa_df) <- c("window_1", "window_2", "rsa_similarity")
```

```{r}
ggplot(rsa_df, aes(x = window_1, y = window_2, fill = rsa_similarity)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = "time window",
       y = "time window",
       fill = "r") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("figures/geometry.png", bg="white")
```
